# Aditya Pawar — Fullstack Developer

> Portfolio for Aditya Pawar, a Pune-based fullstack developer focused on web platforms, REST APIs, secure workflows, and offline-first desktop applications.

## Main sections

- [About Me](https://aditya112-portfolio.vercel.app/#about): Professional background, engineering approach, creative interests, and education.
- [Skills](https://aditya112-portfolio.vercel.app/#skills): TypeScript, React, Next.js, Electron, SQL databases, security, testing, and delivery tooling.
- [Experience](https://aditya112-portfolio.vercel.app/#experience): Production web applications, payment systems, automation, and multi-tenant platforms.
- [Projects](https://aditya112-portfolio.vercel.app/#projects): SynapseState, ScaleERP Desktop, and ScaleERP Web, including feature summaries, technology stacks, source links, and product screenshots.

## Selected work

- [SynapseState](https://github.com/adityapawar112/SynapseState): Incident-safety & lifecycle governance layer for OpenFeature with signed emergency overrides, k3s control plane, Next.js operations portal, Playwright E2E, Stryker mutation testing, and k6 soak benchmarks.
- [ScaleERP Desktop](https://github.com/adityapawar112/ScaleERP-Desktop): Offline-first Electron inventory and billing desktop software with SQLite.
- [ScaleERP Web](https://github.com/adityapawar112/ScaleERP-Web): Next.js and Supabase cloud control plane for trials, licensing, and client telemetry.
- [ScaleERP Live](https://scale-erp.vercel.app/): Live deployment of ScaleERP cloud service.
